title: UFOs showing up at nuclear sites, waiting for humanity to evolve

tellings.quote: some sort of prime directive where they're waiting for us to get less violent. They're keeping an eye on us. They're showing up at nuclear sites which they do at all of our nuclear sites,

related.note: Both concern UFOs appearing at nuclear sites, but this telling explains them as aliens under a prime directive waiting for humanity to become less violent, where the story explains them as future humans guarding their timeline.
Both explain UFOs appearing at nuclear sites, but this telling makes them an Earth 'homeostasis kit' that appears at hinge points rather than watchers waiting for humanity to grow less violent.
Same subject, UFOs over nuclear ICBMs, but the core claim is that they are sending a message, unlike the waiting-for-humanity explanation.

plain: Michels suggests that UFOs keep an eye on humanity and appear at all of our nuclear sites because they follow a kind of "prime directive", a rule of not interfering, while they wait for us to become less violent. He offers this himself, without naming a source. If true, the visitors would be patient watchers holding back until humans grow up.
